description: Monitor a company domain for changes across hiring, tech stack, funding, firmographics, and social since the last run. Returns only what changed as typed change events in flat, Clay-ready JSON. Pass sources to watch fewer than all five sources and min_severity to drop minor changes; each source left out is one fewer sub actor run on the bill. Reads public data and writes nothing; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_name.description: Optional company name hint, used when the domain does not match the brand name, e.g. Deel for deel.com.

domain.description: Company domain to monitor, without https or www, e.g. stripe.com.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional spending cap for this call, in USD, passed to the actor as max_charge_usd. The run stops before any charge that would take it past this amount and keeps every row already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum charge per run set on your Apify account.

min_severity.description: Report only changes at or above this severity. low reports every change and is the default. high keeps leadership moves, funding, acquisitions, and a CRM or sequencer appearing or disappearing.

previous_snapshot.description: Snapshot object returned by a prior run. Supply it and it is the baseline instead of stored state, which is what makes a scheduled run cheap.

sources.description: Which sources to monitor. Omit for all five. Each source left out is one fewer sub actor run per company, so a single source watch is billed for one source, not five.

sub_actor_timeout_secs.description: Per-child run timeout in seconds. Children run in parallel, so total wall time is about the slowest child. Default: 300.

name: get_company_changes
title: Get Company Changes
